caption: The drawing depicts the outline of a person shown from the chest up, wearing a headscarf and a garment with a visible collar and a round clasp or brooch at the neckline. The headscarf is draped over the head and shoulders, featuring a long end that hangs down the left side, with decorative edging. The person’s hair is parted in the middle and styled with visible waves on either side of the head. There is no detail drawn for the eyes, mouth, or other facial features besides minimal lines for the nose and brows. The illustration uses fine black or dark grey lines for the outline, and there is a light application of beige or tan color on the headscarf, one of the hanging ends, and part of the collar. On the right side of the composition, there is a separate, smaller depiction of the same headscarf from a rear or side angle, also outlined and lightly shaded with the same beige color. The background is plain off-white, and the paper shows signs of age with some slight discoloration around the edges.
title: Headdress
